name: protein tyrosine phosphatase receptor type B

function.text: PTPRB encodes receptor-type tyrosine-protein phosphatase beta. Annotated molecular activities include transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase inhibitor activity. It participates in angiogenesis and dephosphorylation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
